reports.title: AvePoint Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: The Company is again raising its full-year guidance for annual recurring revenue, and the Company’s updated full-year guidance for revenue and non-GAAP operating income includes the respective third quarter outperformance relative to guidance. Additionally, the Company’s updated financial guidance reflects the current expected impact from the fluctuation in foreign exchange rates for all metrics.
